summary: The candidate correctly parses Leica units, resolves calibration before measurements in primary entry points, enforces the production checkpoint hash, archives major provenance inputs, and labels repeated-2D-ROI volume as non-anatomical. Acceptance is blocked because manifest-locked calibration trusts stored numeric values without re-parsing or hash-verifying the referenced XML, and batch discovery can silently broaden a failed pattern to unrelated stacks or channels without enforcing unique Z/channel identity.

sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:11297-11472 resolves calibration before use and fails when required discoverable Leica metadata is unavailable.
sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:11343-11370 accepts manifest-locked numeric calibration after checking only XML existence and positivity; it does not parse the XML or verify a retained XML hash.

sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:8142-8158 shape-checks and applies the configured ROI and exclusion mask.

sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:1039-1087 silently falls back from a failed requested pattern to every supported image in the directory and assigns/extracts Z indices without validating a single stack, channel, or unique Z sequence.
sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:8125-8127 converts the resulting files into a files_by_z dictionary, so duplicate Z values from multiple channels can overwrite one another.

findings.title: Manifest-locked Leica calibration is not bound to XML identity or contents
findings.impact: A stale, replaced, malformed, or mismatched Leica XML can exist while the pipeline silently applies numeric XY/Z values retained in a manifest. The subsequently archived XML hash proves only which file was copied, not that the applied calibration was derived from that file. This violates the authoritative hashed mapping requirement and can corrupt every physical measurement and threshold.
evidence: sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:11343-11370 checks only metadata-file existence and positive stored values before returning status leica_xml_manifest_locked.
sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:12295-12319 similarly validates only metadata existence and positivity of manifest calibration values.
tests/test_saturn_v571_audit_blockers.py:297-323 supplies <xml/> and still expects manifest-locked calibration to succeed.
sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:11674-11681 hashes the copied XML only during output archiving, after calibration values have already been trusted.
findings.recommendation: Store the authoritative XML SHA-256 and source-to-XML mapping in the study manifest. Before analysis, verify the XML hash, re-parse its calibration, and require agreement with locked XY/Z values within a declared tolerance. Fail closed on malformed, replaced, ambiguous, or mismatched metadata; add adversarial tests for each case.

findings.title: Batch fallback can mix channels or unrelated stacks and overwrite duplicate Z planes
findings.impact: If the configured glob has a typo or extension mismatch beyond the narrow substitution, the production batch path can ingest every supported image in the folder. Multiple channels or stacks can then share Z indices; files_by_z silently retains only one path per Z, causing source, channel, context-plane, and calibration misalignment.
evidence: sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:1066-1075 broad-scans all supported images when the requested pattern finds nothing.
sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:1080-1087 returns extracted Z indices without rejecting duplicate Z, mixed channel, mixed stack, or unparseable identity.
sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:8125-8127 constructs files_by_z with dictionary overwrite semantics.
sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:10884-10897 provides stricter study filename parsing but it is not applied by load_batch_files.
findings.recommendation: Remove the unrestricted production fallback or filter fallback candidates through the conservative parser and the requested stack/channel identity. Require one stack key, one channel, unique ordered Z indices, consistent shapes, and an unambiguous metadata match before calibration or inference; fail closed otherwise.

limitations: No full image stack was run, as instructed.
Focused pytest execution was unavailable because pytest is not installed in the active Python environment.
Working tree contained an untracked audits/runs/20260821-v571-remediation-acceptance-rc3 directory; it was not read because it may contain other reviewers' outputs.
Review was limited to calibration, source identity, alignment, checkpoint/profile provenance, ROI semantics, and reproducibility artifacts.
